picker.toolsHint: Choose which tools the agent can call. It only ever sees and uses these, in the knowledge bases you select below.

read.label: Read
read.description: Search and read documents. Nothing can be changed.

propose.label: Propose edits
propose.description: Read, edit documents and open pull requests. Pair it with Propose on each knowledge base so every change waits for review.

direct.label: Direct edits
direct.description: Read, edit documents, manage assets and follow or close pull requests. With Write on a knowledge base, changes go straight to its main branch; with only Propose, they open a pull request.

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: A custom set of tool groups. Review them under Advanced.

read.label: Read
read.description: Search, list and read documents. Also needed for Git fetch and asset downloads.

edit.label: Edit
edit.description: Create, update and delete documents, apply changes, and upload Markdown. Also needed for Git push.

assets.label: Assets
assets.description: Upload, import, list and remove images and other assets.

export.label: Export
export.description: Prepare and download exports of a knowledge base.

pull_requests.label: Pull requests
pull_requests.description: List, open and review pull requests.

index_admin.label: Index
index_admin.description: Check index status, rebuild the index and change the embedding profile.

kb_admin.label: Knowledge base admin
kb_admin.description: Create, rename and delete knowledge bases.

sealed.label: Sealed values
sealed.description: Resolve sealed references this credential was approved for.

read.label: Read
read.description: Search and read documents and history.

propose.label: Propose
propose.description: Suggest changes as pull requests. Cannot change the main branch directly.

write.label: Write
write.description: Change the main branch directly, without review.

review.label: Review
review.description: Review, merge or close pull requests. Does not allow editing documents directly.

manage.label: Manage
manage.description: Full control of the knowledge base, including every other permission.

credentials.createUncertain: We could not confirm whether “{{name}}” was created. The token list is being refreshed. Close this dialog, find any new token with that name, and revoke it before trying again: its secret cannot be recovered.
credentials.morePermissions: More knowledge base permissions exist. Load more to inspect them.

edit.title: Edit access for “{{name}}”
edit.description: Widen or narrow what this connection may do. Changes apply to its next call; nothing is reissued.
edit.loadError: Couldn't load this connection's current permissions.
edit.loadAll: This connection has more knowledge base permissions. Load them all before editing.
edit.oauthScopes: An app's access type can't change here. To remove changes, turn off the write tool groups; to add Read and change, reconnect the app and approve it again.
edit.confirmDescription: The existing credential gains this access on its next call. Only widen a connection you still trust.
edit.noExpiryWarning: This token never expires. Prefer temporary access, which ends on its own, or a new token with an expiry instead of permanently widening one that never expires.
edit.saved: Access updated. Reconnect the agent to refresh its tool list.
edit.rejected: The change was not saved. You may no longer hold some of this access, or the connection is no longer active.
edit.rateLimited: Too many changes. Wait a minute and try again.
edit.error: We couldn't confirm the change. Refresh the list to see the connection's current access.
edit.changeCap_one: Every knowledge base limited to: {{bits}} (narrows {{count}} knowledge base)
edit.changeCap_other: Every knowledge base limited to: {{bits}} (narrows {{count}} knowledge bases)
edit.permanentHint: Changes stay until you edit the connection again.
edit.temporaryHint: Temporary access only adds. It ends on its own when the time is up, or when you end it early. The access type can't change temporarily.
edit.temporaryLimit: This connection already has {{max}} temporary grants active. End one before adding more temporary access.

temporaryIssues.limit: This connection already has {{max}} temporary grants active. End one first.
temporaryIssues.removes: Temporary access can only add. Undo the removals, or choose Permanent to remove access.
temporaryIssues.needsWrite: These tools change data, which needs the Read and change access type. Temporary access can't add it.

edit.temporaryConfirm: This access ends on its own after {{duration}}. You can end it earlier from the connection list.
edit.temporaryCreatedKbs: Knowledge bases the agent creates during this time stay accessible to it after the temporary access ends.
edit.savedTemporary: Temporary access added. Reconnect the agent to refresh its tool list.
edit.endsTemporary: This also ends temporary access on this connection.

credentials.resetReviewLoadError: Couldn't check which tokens and apps still work after your password reset.
credentials.revokeAllTitle: Revoke every token and connected app?

credentials.revokeAllSuccess: All tokens and connected apps were revoked.
credentials.revokeAllError: Some credentials were not revoked. Review the list and try again.
